مُؤَرَّبٌ A member, or limb, cut off entire: (T:)
or an entire, unbroken, member, or limb: (S:) and anything made entire, complete, or perfect. (S, K.) You say, كَتِفٌ مُؤَرَّبَةٌ A shoulder cut off entire, (Mgh, TA,) having none of its flesh taken from it, (Mgh,) without any deficiency. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
